# RAIL-BLOC

> RAIL-BLOC (SIH26027) is an AI-powered automatic block-planning system for Indian Railways: departmental maintenance demands are ingested fail-closed (Nexus), scheduled by an interval CP-SAT solver with VRP machine rostering (Optima), independently verified by 10 deterministic G&SR/MILP checks (Sentinel), approved through a hash-bound Sr.DOM → DRM → COA lifecycle, and recorded in a SHA-256 hash-chained tamper-evident ledger (Chronicle). Post-audit hardened v1.1: 54 tracked audit issues filed, 49 closed with code-verified fixes (security, observability, CI, Alembic migrations). All data is simulated; seeds are fixed and reproducible.

Current release: **v1.1.0 (post-audit hardened)**. Status of every claim: `docs/7__Tracker.md` (honest statuses enforced by Rules.md R6.6).

## Architecture

- **Nexus ingestion** (`apps/api/routers/ingest*`, fail-closed): per-source machine credentials (TMS/TDMS/SMMS/FOIS) with timing-safe comparison, staleness TTLs, plausibility-contradiction rejection, weather → defer-not-assume.
- **Optima** (`packages/optima/`): headway-expanded exogenous train paths, one `OptionalIntervalVar` per demand, `NoOverlap` per section, shadow-block bundling, greedy B1 warm start (never worse than baseline), VRP machine rostering; retry ladder with relaxed weights; fixed-seed benchmark harness.
- **Sentinel** (`packages/sentinel/`): G&SR-1..5 + MILP-C1..C5, deterministic, no network/ML/side effects; seals `content_hash`; G&SR-2 gates S&T plans on dual SM+Controller acknowledgment.
- **Plan Lifecycle** (`apps/api/services/plan_lifecycle.py`): revision-number + hash binding; supersede clears sentinel verdict; T-2h structural re-check vs latest train paths; COA outbox (`TRANSMITTED_COA` only on acknowledgment).
- **Chronicle** (`packages/chronicle/`, `data/sql/03_ledger_triggers.sql`): hash chain verified inside PostgreSQL under REPEATABLE READ; advisory-lock serialization; INSERT-only role; 8-process stress → `chain_ok=true`.
- **Security posture**: JWT with `jti` + Redis revocation, per-user PBKDF2 (600k) salts with transparent legacy re-salting, login rate limit (5/min), one-time SSE stream tickets, Redis `--requirepass`, restart policies on all services.
- **Observability**: request-ID middleware, structured JSON logging, Prometheus counters (`REQUESTS_TOTAL`, `OUTBOX_PENDING`).

## API surface (summary)

Base path `/api/v1`. Auth: `POST /auth/login`, `GET /auth/me`. Ingest: demand/traffic/weather ingestion (machine keys). Demands/plans/approvals/emergency/weather/operations: role- and division-scoped routers. `GET /plans/{id}/sentinel-report` (10 checks), `POST /plans/{id}/acknowledge-signal`, `POST /plans/{id}/approve|authorize|transmit`, `GET /ledger/events|verify`, `GET /stream/issue-ticket` + SSE. `GET /health` (DB ping, version). Full table: docs/2__TechSpec.md §4.

## Run & verify

```bash
docker compose up --build          # full stack; migrate + seed run automatically
python -m pytest tests -q          # unit always; integration auto-skip without PG/Redis
cd apps/web && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
```

Prereqs: Docker Compose v2, Python 3.11+, Node 20. First build ~10–25 min. Demo users + walkthrough: MANUAL_STEPS.md.

## Conventions for agents

- Never weaken Sentinel checks or bypass the approval chain; Optima proposes, Sentinel disposes.
- Schema changes → Alembic (`migrations/`); keep `data/sql/02_schema_ddl.sql` fresh-install parity.
- Ledger append-only via `audit.append_event()`; no UPDATE/DELETE paths.
- Status claims require cited evidence (Rules.md R6.6).
- Frontend is Next.js 13 app-router static export (`output: 'export'`), strict TS, vitest + RTL; npm needs `--legacy-peer-deps`.
